programme.title: I was a king - Lucjan Brychczy
programme.desc: A series presenting the profiles of the best scorers in the history of the Premier League. This is a great opportunity to recall the successes of Włodzimierz Lubański, Grzegorz Lata, Kazimierz Kmiecik, Grzegorz Piechna and Tomasz Frankowski. We will get to know different football generations. In the 1960s, Włodzimierz Lubański (Górnik Zabrze) was the top scorer four times in a row. However, in the 1970s, Kazimierz Kmiecik (Wisła Kraków) and Grzegorz Lato (Stal Mielec) reigned supreme. In more modern times, Tomasz Frankowski won four titles in the colors of Wisła Kraków and Jagiellonia Białystok. There will also be the story of Grzegorz Piechna, the unexpected top scorer from Korona Kielce in 2006. Lucjan Brychczy is a true legend of Legia Warsaw. He was a man deeply experienced in life. For a child harmed by the war, football was a way to survive in difficult times. He was associated with the capital club from 1954 until his death in 2024. Poland. 2022-2025. documentary series

programme.title: Australian gold diggers | S01E06
programme.desc: Taking place in the beautiful, yet harsh scenery of Western Australia, the series shows the struggles of daredevils exploring deposits of precious metal. We follow three teams of searchers as they brave heat, equipment failure, and exhausting pressure. Christine and Greg Clark - aka Gold Gypsies - put it all on one card. Driven by gold fever, they abandoned their careers and their home in Brisbane. Vern Strange and his friend Leon Marsh form the band Dirt Dogs. They have invested as much as one million dollars in equipment and are anxiously awaiting profits. Kellie Carter and Henri Chassaing chose a different strategy. The friends venture into the wild, hoping to find previously undiscovered deposits. Kellie and Henri receive disturbing news that forces them to give up their search for gold. The companions rush to protect the premises of their lease from uninvited guests. Unexpected adversities mean that a team may fail to achieve its goal. Vern and Leon decide to start searching for a new deposit. While on the road, newcomer Lindsay makes a once-in-a-lifetime discovery. Meanwhile, on the hill, the Clarks notice a quartz deposit, which convinces them that they are one step away from a gold mine. Australia. 2016. documentary series

programme.title: River Monsters 6 – Body Snatcher | S06E06
programme.desc: Once again, Jeremy Wade sets off in search of bloodthirsty fish. During his expedition, he visits different parts of the world. He tries to capture dangerous creatures to see if they are actually able to attack people and harm them. Jeremy knows well what the locals call ghost stories about body snatchers. USA. 2014. documentary series

programme.title: River Monsters 7 – Mekong Monster | S07E01
programme.desc: Jeremy Wade sets out to find bloodthirsty fish. During his expedition, he visits different parts of the world. He tries to capture dangerous creatures to see if they are actually able to attack people and harm them. Jeremy Wade combs the banks of the Mekong River in Asia. He is looking for a mysterious river creature that supposedly burrowed itself into the body of a young man. Great Britain. 2015. documentary series

programme.title: River Monsters 7 – The Most Dangerous in Africa | S07E02
programme.desc: Jeremy Wade sets out to find bloodthirsty fish. During his expedition, he visits different parts of the world. He tries to capture dangerous creatures to see if they are actually able to attack people and harm them. Jeremy Wade returns to the Okavango Delta. He wants to investigate the case of carnivores hunting in herds that mauled the passengers of the capsized boat. Great Britain. 2015. documentary series

programme.title: River Monsters 7 – Alaskan Water Killer | S07E03
programme.desc: Jeremy Wade sets out to find bloodthirsty fish. During his expedition, he visits different parts of the world. He tries to capture dangerous creatures to see if they are actually able to attack people and harm them. Fishermen in the wild and remote corners of Alaska have been dying under mysterious circumstances for years. Jeremy Wade follows them. Great Britain. 2015. documentary series

programme.title: River Monsters 7 – Canadian Horror | S07E04
programme.desc: Jeremy Wade sets out to find bloodthirsty fish. During his expedition, he visits different parts of the world. He tries to capture dangerous creatures to see if they are actually able to attack people and harm them. Jeremy Wade checks how much truth there is in the stories about a Canadian lake monster that attacks people. He sets out to search for the monster. Great Britain. 2015. documentary series

programme.title: African predators: the big four – Leopards | E02
programme.desc: The lives of the four largest predators living in Africa will be presented. The creators will look at their hunting methods, competition in herds, as well as strategies that ensure their survival in sometimes difficult conditions... Spain, Great Britain. 2024. documentary series

programme.title: Pacific – Shallows | S01E02
programme.desc: The creators of the program talk about the Pacific Ocean, the largest ocean in the world, covering an area of ​​170 million square kilometers. Viewers will have the opportunity to look at the coral reef and see the local beaches and capes. They will also learn about the inhabitants of water, from crabs and sea cows to the more predatory rulers of the ocean. Viewers go to the shallow waters of the Pacific and watch the exploits of the dolphins living there. Then they visit the largest coral reef in the world and take part in an animal gathering in which future mother turtles also participate. Canada. 2020. documentary series

programme.title: Secrets of water lands – Rivers | S01E03
programme.desc: The authors invite viewers on underwater journeys through oceans, swamps and other water areas from various parts of the world. In each episode, they show the richness of the ecosystems they visit, presenting the complex relationships between the organisms inhabiting them. Viewers will learn about the ecosystems that have developed in waterways in various parts of the world - from volcanic rivers in eastern Russia to geothermal streams in Florida. Filmmakers observe, among others: the activity of beavers, which gives a unique character to river landscapes, as well as the winter spa of manatees. Great Britain. 2025. nature series

programme.title: Canada: Survive in the wild North
programme.desc: Canada has the world's largest area of ​​intact primeval forest, over two million lakes and rivers, and the longest coastline on Earth. This wild and rugged area is inhabited by many fascinating wild animals. These include bears, arctic foxes, wolves, Canadian lynxes, flying owls, great owls, caribou and seals. Viewers will see how fauna copes in such difficult conditions to survive, taking advantage of the opportunities offered to representatives of various species in each season... USA, Canada, Austria. 2022. documentary film

programme.title: In Search of Rain | E04
programme.desc: A herd of elephants faces a challenge when the river dries up due to lack of rain. Phoenix, the leader of a pack of wild dogs, is fighting against time: she must feed five puppies... Canada. 2022. documentary series

programme.title: Snow creatures
programme.desc: Animals must have a variety of tactics prepared to survive in one of the coldest places on our planet. From finding a convenient place to hunt to a shelter where they can raise their offspring. Nature film presenter Liz Bonnin will show viewers how animals cope in such difficult conditions... Great Britain. 2019. documentary film

programme.title: Giants – Anacondas | E04
programme.desc: Dan O'Neill sets off to Kenya on a mission to find, film and measure the largest elephants on the planet. Dan O'Neill sets out to find the largest living anaconda. He joins Dr. Juliana Terry, an expert on these snakes, in hopes of tracking down a giant female green anaconda. Great Britain. 2023. documentary series

programme.title: Deadly Weather 2 | S02E09
programme.desc: Stories of people who encountered and recorded the most dangerous weather phenomena. Each episode presents blood-curdling footage from witnesses who survived fires, floods, tsunamis, hurricanes, avalanches, snowstorms and maritime disasters. There will also be reports from rescue operations. A bomb cyclone, an extremely rare and violent atmospheric phenomenon, suddenly developed in northeastern America, causing a huge pileup on a highway and terrorizing the passengers of a cruise ship battered by huge waves. Great Britain. 2018. documentary series

programme.title: Animal Wars – In the Heat | E02
programme.desc: Animal species will be presented that can use their amazing features to defeat sometimes larger opponents. By perfecting them, they became true masters of communication, combat and camouflage... Great Britain. 2023. documentary series

programme.title: Atlantic – the wildest ocean – Underwater mountains | E02
programme.desc: Narrator Cillian Murphy reveals the incredible, surprising and resilient inhabitants of the Atlantic - both animal and human. Every day they face the wildest ocean in the world. Viewers will learn what the mountains that rise from the bottom of the Atlantic look like. The Mid-Atlantic Ridge, supporting oceanic flora and fauna, is considered the longest mountain range on earth. Great Britain. 2015. documentary film

programme.title: Secrets of water lands – Lakes | S01E04

With moray eels, schools of rays, and thousands of other creatures, these sunken ships have become vibrant marine habitats | This show takes the viewer on an underwater journey of discovery to explore the hidden world of sunken wrecks. The ocean floor is littered with centuries' worth of vessels that met an unfortunate end and were dragged to the depths. However, over many years, these wrecks have been transformed into artificial reefs that provide shelter and home to a multitude of plant and animal marine life. Each episode focuses on different locations such as the unique collection of wrecks found around the small Caribbean island of Bonaire; the vessels that were deliberately scuppered off the coast of Roatan; the wrecks around the coast of the Yucatan peninsula that provide a special environment for sweepers, groupers and the whale shark to thirve; and the ruined planes and ships surrounding New Providence in the Bahamas that were used in Hollywood movies | Director: Andrew Killawee

programme.desc: 2016 г. Год: 2016. Страна: JAV, Kanada. Год: 2016. S1, Ep5 «Reef Wrecks»…From opportunistic pirate ships to well-armed navy vessels, the Yucatan Peninsula is home to a variety of reef wrecks. With moray eels, schools of rays, and thousands of other creatures, these sunken ships have become vibrant marine habitats | This show takes the viewer on an underwater journey of discovery to explore the hidden world of sunken wrecks. The ocean floor is littered with centuries' worth of vessels that met an unfortunate end and were dragged to the depths. However, over many years, these wrecks have been transformed into artificial reefs that provide shelter and home to a multitude of plant and animal marine life. Each episode focuses on different locations such as the unique collection of wrecks found around the small Caribbean island of Bonaire; the vessels that were deliberately scuppered off the coast of Roatan; the wrecks around the coast of the Yucatan peninsula that provide a special environment for sweepers, groupers and the whale shark to thirve; and the ruined planes and ships surrounding New Providence in the Bahamas that were used in Hollywood movies | Director: Andrew Killawee

programme.desc: The Mediterranean as we know it seems unchanged: blue seas, idyllic beaches and rocky shores. However, over the millennia its contours changed and it was part of the process as Africa and Europe moved closer together. This process of formation, movement of continents and the emergence of new geographical features has created amazing natural phenomena. 2023

programme.title: Canadian Arctic Archipelago. habitable earth
programme.desc: Embark on a journey through one of the most remote corners of the planet - the Canadian Arctic Archipelago. The documentary will reveal to you the secrets of a land where life seems impossible, but still exists. You will get acquainted with unique species of animals that have managed to adapt to extreme conditions, and also learn the stories of the people inhabiting these harsh lands. educational

programme.title: d/f Animals at night
programme.desc: After sunset, nature does not freeze - it changes its face. While some animals fall asleep, others go out hunting. Night animals act quickly: you need to get food, avoid enemies and not miss a minute. Among them are not only large predators, but also tiny creatures forced to take risks in order to survive. How do they navigate in the dark? Why do they prefer a nocturnal lifestyle? Modern technologies have helped scientists look into this world and uncover the secrets of nighttime activity.

programme.title: d/s Wildlife Science. 2 s.
programme.desc: What is behind the behavior of the most dangerous animals on the planet - lions, sharks, brown bears and rhinoceroses? The series explores their rare behaviors, unexpected hunting strategies, and hidden adaptation mechanisms. Through observation and scientific data, how these animals survive in extreme conditions is revealed.

programme.title: d/s Natural family ties. Friends forever
programme.desc: Experience the close friendships that some wild creatures form and understand the importance of having true allies in the animal kingdom. Explore group dynamics and building trust. Dir.: Juan Luis Santos. Spain, 2022

programme.title: d/f Bambi. The story of life in the forest
programme.desc: We will go on an exciting journey through the mysterious forest together with little Bambi, who is just beginning to comprehend the secrets of this world. He will discover the wonders of nature, make true friends and learn to overcome difficulties. When autumn comes, the cute fawn faces great grief - separation from its mother. Can he find the strength to grow up, overcome his loss, and become a courageous leader worthy of his family?

programme.desc: In the Sierra Morena mountains, in the south of the Iberian Peninsula, hides the rarest predator in Europe - the Iberian lynx. This species was once on the verge of extinction, but the efforts of scientists and conservationists gave it a chance for salvation. The film shows the daily life of a lynx family, the struggle for survival, hunting, caring for cubs. Spain, 2024

These include woodpeckers, who every day save trees from death and transform the environment with their routine. France, 2023

programme.title: d/f Giants of Wildlife. 4 s.
programme.desc: There are animals of different sizes in nature, and the larger ones face the difficulty of always being visible. In the film we will meet such giants of nature who skillfully adapted to the conditions of wild life, using their power, strength and size to survive. 2023

programme.title: THỬ THÁCH TỘT ĐỘ - EXTREME ENDS
programme.desc: Extreme Ends là một chương trình thực tế phiêu lưu hành động có sự góp mặt của bốn nhân vật nổi tiếng và những vị khách đặc biệt của họ trải nghiệm sự đa dạng của Hồng Kông! Hãy tham gia cùng các người mẫu nổi tiếng Indonesia Patricia và Chika khi họ khám phá những viên ngọc ẩn giấu và khung cảnh sôi động của thành phố, đắm mình trong sự tương phản đáng kinh ngạc và những rung cảm thời thượng.

programme.title: TAY ĐẤM HUYỀN THOẠI - FIST OF LEGEND
programme.desc: Khi Chen Zhen học ở Nhật Bản, anh phát hiện một số sinh viên Trung Quốc mất tích và vô tình phát hiện ra âm mưu của Hội Rồng Đen. Một loại thuốc mới được phát minh để tăng cường sức khỏe cho quân đội Nhật Bản trong chiến tranh và các sinh viên Trung Quốc được sử dụng trong thí nghiệm của họ. Chen Zhen thề sẽ tiêu diệt tổ chức tà ác và phá hủy phòng thí nghiệm bí mật của chúng.

programme.title: KỲ NGHỈ CỦA ĐẤNG MÀY RÂU - THE ULTIMATE BROCATION
programme.desc: Một chương trình thực tế vui nhộn kể về bốn nam nhân vật nổi tiếng đến từ các quốc gia khác nhau trong một kỳ nghỉ giả tưởng được đài thọ toàn bộ chi phí ở Hồng Kông, được thiết kế riêng cho các “anh em”!

programme.title: ANH HÙNG THỜI LOẠN - YOUNG HEROES OF CHAOTIC TIMES
programme.desc: Câu chuyện này lấy bối cảnh ở Thượng Hải vào cuối triều đại nhà Thanh, kể về một chàng trai trẻ, Chen Zhen, người đã vươn lên trở thành anh hùng dân tộc sau khi chịu đựng gian khổ và vượt qua thử thách trong cuộc sống.

programme.title: BIỆT ĐỘI BÔNG HỒNG THÉP - IRON SQUAD W
programme.desc: Mùa thứ tư của chương trình sinh tồn quân sự Hàn Quốc này sẽ quyết định nữ quân nhân ưu tú nhất. Nó tập hợp sáu đơn vị Lực lượng Đặc biệt để cạnh tranh trong các nhiệm vụ đầy thử thách trên bộ, trên biển và trên không. Những nữ quân nhân dự bị hàng đầu thành lập các đội gồm bốn người để thi đấu với nhau. Chứng kiến ​​cách họ chiến đấu đến cùng trước sáu người dẫn chương trình nổi tiếng!

programme.title: HUYẾT CHIẾN - BURNING BLOOD
programme.desc: Các thành viên của đội chống ma túy—Tai Hua, Lao Mi, Ah Feng và Ah Tang—có liên quan đến việc bắt giữ một trùm ma túy. Tuy nhiên, sự phản bội của cảnh sát đã dẫn đến cái chết của Ah Feng và cấp trên của anh ta, còn Ah Tang thì biến mất. Khi Tai Hua và Lao Mi phát hiện ra sự thật, họ thấy mình bị giằng xé giữa lòng trung thành và sự phản bội trong cuộc chiến chống lại băng đảng ma túy.
